notes.title: Update 1.1.0 d
notes.notes:
GPU Support:
- New model installations should work with RTX 5000 series.

Models:
- Added Distill-Any-Depth and Video-Depth-Anything models.
- Added TensorRT version for Depth-Anything, Depth-Anything-V2, Depth-Anything-V2-Metric, Distill-Any-Depth and Video-Depth-Anything.
- Small adjustments to launch script Depth-Anything models and Marigold, available when installing/reinstalling the model.

General Features:
- Added Anaglyph mode.
- Added support for Half-SBS screen when Deep Desktop window aspect ratio is less than 25/9.
- Added the possibility to use cached files when installing models, requires to be on the beta-install-cache branch to use.
- Added the possibility to use VR Controllers in the menus.
- Added Window selection mode, the list can be refreshed by pressing R, 
- Added FLAT - IMMERSIVE, FLAT - IMMERSIVE 2, CURVED and FRAME screen shapes.
- Added Thread Count option to reduce CPU load for some models.
- Added display of settings values.
- Added -no-oxr launch option to stop Deep Desktop from using OpenXR at launch.
- Added flicker reduction option in Background | Filters menu.
- Added the possibility to load image files when using the Video Mode.
- Added basic ratings for the models.

Bugs:
- Fixing black bars when using SBS mode.
- Fixing crash when using lower screen resolution multipliers
- Fixed auto start not working

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 c
notes.notes:
Translations:
- Adding support for the Chinese language (thanks to the contribution of the user LaiYangLi)

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 b
notes.notes:
New Features:
- Adding Side by side mode to allow Deep Desktop to be used with AR glasses.
- Adding basic support for Xreal glasses (air 1, 2 and 2 pro) head tracking (tend to get misaligned with the initial position after a few minutes)
- Adding depth estimation edge smoothing (to be enabled in the model settings)
- Adding horizontal cropping
- Adding loop button for video mode
- Adding Depth Pro model (require a GPU with at least 16GB of VRAM to be used without problem)

Model Changes:
- Adding half precision toggle for new installations of Depth-Anything, Depth-Anything V2 and Depth-Anything V2 Metric models.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
So the version 1.1.0 is live. Even though there was a lot of code changes in the background, normally the experience should not be too different compared to version 1.0.4.

You will be asked if you want to delete the models installations when first launching the program. If you want to go back to version 1.0.4 at some point, you should say no to this prompt but be aware that models installations are not compatible between both versions.

Here is a list of the main changes:

All Modes:
- Models settings are now saved.
- 180° and 360° screen shapes are now selectable. To be used with 180° or 360° videos, some can be found there (they need to be downloaded): https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzuqhhs6NWbgTzMuM09WKDQ
- UI buttons are slightly smaller to allow for more options to be displayed.

Screen Capture Mode:
- Vertical cropping as been added to reduce the vertical size of the area sent to the depth estimation

Video Mode:
- Introduction of the video mode, which allow you to select a video file to be read. 
- .mkv format is not supported as the Unity video player doesn't handle that format.
- Moving the mouse while playing a video will show the Deep Desktop interface and allow you to make changes to settings.
- Caching options allow saving depth estimations for later watching of videos.
- NOTE: Performance doesn't scale well with high resolutions, so 4K videos might be better being read using screen capture.

Extensions:
- So the purpose of extensions is to allow programs that do other things than Depth estimation to be run in the background and provide other features. For now, I did only put PaddloOCR for text extraction and both Deep Translator and PyKakasi (for japanese kanji to kana "translation") for translation extensions. To use the translation extensions you need to have a text extraction plugin installed. Settings for translations need to be adjusted in the Extensions tab in the Screen Capture or Video menu.
- Extensions can be turned on in the Extensions menu, they are off by default after having been installed

Models:
- Added the Depth-AnythingV2-Metric model
- Fixes to the Marigold model as it has many issues when rendering the result

notes.title: Crash Fix Update 1.0.4c
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Forcing the usage of pytorch version 1.23.0 when using the Nvidia CUDA version as the latest 1.24.0 version was requiring a DLL that is not installable using Redistribuable right now. 

If you have installed models in the last 2 days and experienced the "Depth Extractor crashed" error, I invite you to go to the Local menu, delete the defective model and to reinstall it.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4b
notes.notes:
Features
- Adding "Unlock head movements" option. This allows you to move your head freely but expect the screen to be slightly distorted when not in the "optimal" position.
- Adding warning text for the "delete models" option to insure that users are aware that the content of the folder will be deleted when they are using a custom folder. The default path to the models is also displayed by default now.
- Adding F1 to F12 shortcut buttons. They can be used even if Deep Desktop is not the focused window.
- Switching from Arrow buttons to Tabs buttons in the capture menu.
- The cursor is automaticaly moved to the window when launching the program. This behavior can also be mapped to a shortcut. Ideally would have also brought the window to the foreground but the behaviour was inconsistent so it was removed for now.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Features
- All the following settings can be accessed by clicking on the left or right arrow on the screen.
- Adding chroma key filter, rendering screen transparent when a color is close to the one selected.
- Adding depth filter, rendering screen transparent when estimated depth is below a selected threshold.
- Adding main menu in VR space, window still need to have focus to use it, a message will be displayed if that's not the case.
- Adding one color background setting.
- Adding RGB selection for colors.
- Adding possibility to use custom background image such as png, jpg and hdr files.
- Adding ambient color background, color of the background change depending on the content displayed on the screen.
- Moving the background colors and star intensity settings to the capture screen instead of the options menu.
- Adding multiple languages as beta languages, you can contribute to it by doing in the pinned steam forum discussion if you find potential improvements to the translations.

Bugs
- Fixing crash when pixel count of the capture is above 10000000. This fix require a new install of the model.
- Trying to fix failing git repositories copies due to conflicting older git installation by trying to directly download repositories using URLs when git fail to clone.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Features:
Adding VR controllers support to move around : 


Thumbstick/Trackpad : move forward/backward/left/right (for the trackpad you need to not press it)
Thumbstick pressed/Trackpad pressed : reset camera position
Trigger : go up
Squeeze button : go down
Menu button : set screen direction 

Adding ability to use custom folder :


Go to Options
Create the folder in which you want the models to be installed using windows explorer
Copy the link to this folder
Paste this link in the Path text box
Press the blue Change button

Adding Depth-Anything V2 model

Bug fix:

Fixing issue when having VR controllers on and trying to click on the interface
